request.prompt: Create one production candidate bitmap for the Armax Relay Clash 2D fighting-game art catalog, faithfully studying the supplied original game-model reference. A single full-body subject only, isolated on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, no scenery, no floor plane or ground shadow, no lettering, no caption, no border, no diagram, no contact sheet, no repeated views, no logo added outside the subject. Clean readable silhouette, detailed realistic game-model materials, restrained neutral studio illumination. Show a three-quarter front view with the subject oriented toward screen-right, camera level and minimal perspective distortion. The complete head, equipment, limbs and feet must fit; leave at least six percent transparent breathing room on every side. Preserve the reference's real anatomy, panel construction, proportions, asymmetric equipment and exact costume palette. Do not redesign or modernize. Subject: ONE LOKI bipedal security mech from Mass Effect 2. The supplied reference shows two humanoid views on the LEFT and a different quadruped on the right: reproduce ONLY the tall slender LEFT humanoid mech and its model-specific pistol. Its narrow dark mechanical frame has smooth off-white shoulder, upper arm, torso, hip, shin and boot armor, exposed black pistons and circular joints, bright thin red ring accents around the round shoulder and hip discs. The elongated rounded helmet/head has white shell sides and a dark face plate displaying TWO vertically stacked open red rings forming its distinctive red symbol, a small purple lower sensor and one thin upright antenna. Preserve the narrow waist, pointed white chest shell, long open mechanical lower legs, round ankle bearings and broad smooth flat white feet from the reference. No organic face, no turian head, no geth optic, no legion fabric. Match the pistol shown in the sheet in its ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand, held forward and slightly up in a calm ready pose; left arm bent close to body with a simple mechanical hand. Do not include any quadruped, any duplicate view or any second subject. Maintain the game's exact slim proportions, red optics and white-grey material distribution.
